summary: Short kerb beside a commercial car park, with cars parked nearby.

drivers.seclusion: East side is a tree-lined verge and a commercial car park; nearest mapped buildings are the swim school 28 m and other non-residential buildings; no dwellings seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a tree and verge strip; section is only 10 m, so a van fits with little to spare.
drivers.traffic: Business side street off Witton Road; light traffic, quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked on both kerbs just north and south; 2P applies Mon-Fri 9am-6pm and Sat to noon.

flags: A No Stopping Any Time sign sits 2 m from this stretch; check on site
Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, Witton Creek 57 m away
Section is only about one van length
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the east and north; otherwise open.
cannot_judge: Which sign applies to the exact spot

best_section.where: East kerb of Rennies Road, under the street trees beside the commercial car park
